sections.markdown:
### Use Case: Aggregation Queries
Avg, min, max, rate, sum, count, p99, p95, p90, mean, median

* [Aggregations](https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/platform/grail/dynatrace-query-language/functions/aggregation-functions)

input.value:
fetch logs
| limit 1000
| fields timestamp
| fieldsAdd value = random() * random() * 100
| summarize {avg = avg(value), min = min(value), max = max(value), sum = sum(value), `p99` = percentile(value,99), `p95` = percentile(value,95), `p90` = percentile(value,90), mean = avg(value), `median` = median(value)}

grail.canonicalQuery:

* [Dynatrace Pattern Language (DPL)](https://docs.dynatrace.com/docs/platform/grail/dynatrace-pattern-language)

input.value:
fetch logs
| filter dt.entity.kubernetes_cluster == "KUBERNETES_CLUSTER-3B35FD527F215102" or in(dt.entity.kubernetes_cluster, "KUBERNETES_CLUSTER-3B35FD527F215102")
| filter in(dt.entity.process_group,{"PROCESS_GROUP-99ACC999F4A8B60A", "PROCESS_GROUP-CD5985CF01E9E36E"})
| filter matchesValue(k8s.container.name,"controller")
| limit 500
| fields timestamp, content, k8s.container.name
| parse content, "IPADDR LD '[' HTTPDATE ']' SPACE DQS:http_request SPACE INTEGER:http_status_code SPACE INTEGER:http_bytes LD DQS SPACE DQS SPACE LD '[' LD:http_host ']'"
| fields timestamp, http_request, http_host, http_status_code, k8s.container.name, content

fetch bizevents
| filter event.provider == "www.easytrade.com"
| filter event.type == "com.easytrade.nginx.credit-card-latest-status"
| filterOut isNull(trace_id)
| limit 500
| join [fetch logs
        | filter k8s.namespace.name == "easytrade"
        | filter isNotNull(trace_id)],
    kind: inner,
    on: { trace_id },
    executionOrder: leftFirst,
    fields: { log.timestamp = timestamp, content }
| fieldsAdd timestamp.diff = timestamp - log.timestamp
| fields timestamp, log.timestamp, timestamp.diff, event.provider, event.type, span_id, trace_id, content
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 500

grail.canonicalQuery:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.provider == "www.easytrade.com"
| filter event.type == "com.easytrade.nginx.credit-card-latest-status"
| filterOut isNull(trace_id)
| limit 500
| join 
	[
		fetch logs
		| filter k8s.namespace.name == "easytrade"
		| filter isNotNull(trace_id)
	], kind:inner, executionOrder:leftFirst, on:{trace_id}, fields:{log.timestamp = timestamp, content}
| fieldsAdd timestamp.diff = timestamp - log.timestamp
| fields timestamp, log.timestamp, timestamp.diff, event.provider, event.type, span_id, trace_id, content
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 500

input.value:
fetch dt.entity.service
| filter id == "SERVICE-CBE301375B4AD11E"
| filter entity.name == "adservice"
| lookup [timeseries {count = sum(`dt.service.request.count`),
                      response_time = avg(`dt.service.request.response_time`),
                      failure_count = sum(`dt.service.request.failure_count`)},
                      by:{`dt.entity.service`}, filter:`dt.entity.service`=="SERVICE-CBE301375B4AD11E"
          | fieldsAdd requests = arraySum(count), latency = arrayAvg(response_time), failures = arraySum(failure_count)], sourceField: id, lookupField:dt.entity.service, prefix: "service."
| lookup [fetch logs
          | filter dt.entity.service == "SERVICE-CBE301375B4AD11E"
          | summarize {total_logs = count(), error_logs = countIf(status == "ERROR")}, by: {dt.entity.service}], sourceField: id, lookupField: dt.entity.service, prefix: "logs."
| lookup [timeseries {sum_ad_requests = sum(`app.ads.ad_requests`),
                      avg_jvm_cpu = avg(`process.runtime.jvm.cpu.utilization`),
                      avg_jvm_mem = avg(`process.runtime.jvm.memory.usage`)},
                      by:{`dt.entity.service`}, filter:`dt.entity.service`=="SERVICE-CBE301375B4AD11E"
          | fieldsAdd ad_requests = arraySum(sum_ad_requests), jvm_cpu = arrayAvg(avg_jvm_cpu), jvm_mem = arrayAvg(avg_jvm_mem)], sourceField: id, lookupField:dt.entity.service, prefix: "metrics."
| fields microservice = entity.name, id, service.requests, service.latency, service.failures, logs.total_logs, logs.error_logs, metrics.ad_requests, metrics.jvm_cpu, metrics.jvm_mem

| limit 50
| fieldsAdd methodName = json_content.protoPayload[methodName]
| fields timestamp, methodName, content, json_content

fetch logs
| filter cloud.provider == "Azure"
| fields timestamp, 
  content, azure.resource.group, azure.resource.id, azure.resource.name, azure.subscription, 
  cloud.provider, dt.source_entity, event.type, faas.instance, faas.version, 
  loglevel, cloud.log_forwarder, dt.auth.origin, dt.openpipeline.pipelines, message
| fieldsAdd test16 = 16
| fieldsAdd test17 = 17
| fieldsAdd test18 = 18
| fieldsAdd test19 = 19
| fieldsAdd test20 = 20
| filter contains(content, "EASYTRAVELAZURE") 
  or azure.resource.group == "EASYTRAVELAZURE" 
  or contains(azure.resource.id, "5399") 
  or azure.resource.name == "EASYTRAVELAZUREFUNCTIONAPP" 
  or azure.subscription == "0BA838B1-5399-4A07-8496-EAE30FEB5CE5" 
  or cloud.provider == "Azure" 
  or contains(dt.source_entity, "FUNCTION_APP") 
  or event.type == "LOG" 
  or isNotNull(faas.instance) 
  or isNotNull(faas.version) 
  or loglevel == "INFO" 
  or contains(cloud.log_forwarder, "EventHub") 
  or contains(dt.auth.origin, "dt") 
  or dt.openpipeline.pipelines == "logs:default" 
  or isNotNull(message) 
  or test16 == 16 
  or test17 == 17 
  or test18 == 18 
  or test19 == 19 
  or test20 == 20
